name: 世纪
english_description: Self-titled "Century" (the login banner's copyright notice carries the tagline "Star Wars Heroes in a World of Chaos and Dust"). New characters start out at the Tianlang sector hub and choose one of four rival factions to join — Phoenix Star, the Royal House, the Holy Temple, or the Special Forces — while a starport space station repairs damaged warships and refuels them for electronic currency, a genuinely sci-fi-flavored spin on the usual wuxia sect structure. Wizard rank carries the flashy in-game title "Cosmic Special Police" rather than a generic admin label. Room-for-room, this world is almost entirely identical to sibling archive sj ("Galaxy Century") — same Tianlang/faction/starport content down to matching files — the two differ mainly in their security-daemon/master-object implementation, making them separate server deployments of the same authored game rather than independent titles; a leftover chess-parlor room still describes itself as sitting in ancient Chang'an, a holdover from whatever wuxia-themed base this sci-fi reskin was built on.
